description: Schema + plan or write -> SQLite SQL text and bind values, or the compile error. Golden from core/compile.

vectors.name: DDL [columns]
vectors.why: every column type and CHECK, plus both indexes

statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "_creationTime" INTEGER NOT NULL, "_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("_version" >= 1), "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "score" REAL NOT NULL, "rank" INTEGER NOT NULL, "done" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("done" IN (0, 1)), "tag" TEXT CHECK ("tag" IN ('a', 'b')), "tags" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("tags" IS NULL OR json_valid("tags")), "grid" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("grid" IS NULL OR json_valid("grid")), "owner" TEXT) STRICT
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_notes_by_rank" ON "notes" ("rank")
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "lists" ("_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "_creationTime" INTEGER NOT NULL, "_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("_version" >= 1), "name" TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "entries" ("_id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL, "_creationTime" INTEGER NOT NULL, "_version" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("_version" >= 1), "listId" TEXT NOT NULL, "n" INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_entries_by_list" ON "entries" ("listId", "n")

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "idx_entries_by_list" ON "entries" (json_extract("doc", '$.listId'), json_extract("doc", '$.n'))
